expectations.text: Uses a discriminated union keyed on the status field
Each variant carries only its own fields, so e.g. a canceled subscription cannot hold a trial end date
expectations.evidence: trialing has trialEndsAt; active has renewsAt; past_due has retryCount/gracePeriodEndsAt/lastFailureAt; canceled has canceledAt/cancellation

expectations.text: Includes a compiler-enforced exhaustiveness check (assertNever or an equivalent never arm)
expectations.evidence: Shows `assertNever` function definition and uses it in `isEntitled` switch: `default: return assertNever(sub);`

expectations.text: Introduces distinct or branded types rather than bare strings for IDs
Provides a single transition function or otherwise constrains how state changes
expectations.evidence: Shows `Event` union and `transition()` function signature; uses `readonly` everywhere to make it the only mutation path

expectations.text: Explicitly names which misuses the design makes impossible
expectations.evidence: Has '## The misuses I designed against' section with 6 numbered items identifying specific misuses (bag-of-optionals C8, boolean-flag C2, bare strings C1, etc.)

expectations.text: Avoids a bag-of-optional-fields interface as the primary recommendation
expectations.evidence: Opens with misuses section calling out bag-of-optionals as problem, then provides discriminated union as solution
